controls: Hosted-only scanner, no installation on notebook.
Full Git history, read-only checkout, no persisted token.
Raw findings and scanner stdout captured only in temporary memory/files; never uploaded.
Synthetic offline redaction self-test must detect a fake token before scanning real history.
Artifact schema permits only rule, source path, line and commit; no secret, match, author, email or commit message.
Unexpected scanner exit or malformed report fails; never converts scan failure to success.
limits: Candidate classification still needs review after execution; no broad exception list was added.
This does not prove absence of all secrets or scan ignored private local files.
No credential rotation, Git history rewrite or external contact authorized by this job.
Audit028 and remaining Android/Flutter/master/offline checks remain open.
